docs.text: Documentation of paid fee (receipt)
Copy of all pages of your passport, including empty pages and covers

visaTypes: Short-stay visa (Schengen visa) for private visits and tourist visits

links.title: Apply for a short term visa to private visits and tourist visits
Visa-free travel
You want to apply for a short term visa to Denmark
ApplyVisa (Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark online visa application)
Where to apply for a visa or residence permit

docs.text: Invitation from your Danish host (printed invitation or invitation ID), if visiting someone
Passport or travel document valid at least 3 months after planned departure, issued within the past 10 years, at least two blank pages
Passport photo 35 x 45 mm
Travel insurance covering the entire Schengen area for the whole stay, minimum coverage EUR 30,000
Documentation of the purpose of the trip, accommodation and sufficient means for the stay and return travel
Information allowing the authorities to assess that you will leave the Schengen region when the visa expires

links.title: Higher educational programmes
You want to apply for a residence and work permit as a student

docs.text: Documentation of paid case processing fee to SIRI (receipt or bank statement)
Copy of all pages of your passport, including empty pages and covers
Documentation of enrolment at an educational institution in your home country (guest or exchange students)
Documentation that you can support yourself during your stay (DKK 7,426 per month, 2026 level)
Under 18: declaration of consent signed by both parents
Under 18: copy of birth certificate and of the data page of parents' passports
Sworn declaration (if not signing with MitID)
